meta_title: Why Choose SN Cleaning Services for Mattress Cleaning
meta_description: Mattress cleaning in London and Essex without judgement: dust mites, stains and odours treated, safe for children's beds once dry, and priced by size.
h1: A fresh mattress, cleaned where sheets can't reach
intro: You change the sheets, you might even turn it now and then, but the mattress itself never goes in the wash. If you're thinking about a clean because of allergies, an accident, an illness in the house or a move, you're not being fussy. You're right to.

understand.heading: Why people book a mattress clean
paragraphs: Most people who ask us about mattress cleaning have a very specific reason. A child who's had an accident in the night. Someone in the house with allergies who wakes up stuffy every morning. A bout of illness that's finally over. A rented flat with a mattress you'd rather not think about too hard, or one you're leaving behind at the end of a tenancy.

Some feel a little embarrassed asking. There's honestly no need. Every mattress collects sweat, skin, dust mites and the odd spill over the years, even with clean sheets on top, and dealing with that is exactly what this service is for. Nothing you tell us will surprise us.
The other worry is practical: where you'll sleep tonight. Our fast dry technique means most mattresses are dry within a few hours, so the bed isn't out of action for long.

different.heading: What we do differently, and why it matters to you

items.title: Dust mites treated across the whole surface
items.text: Not just the stains you can see. The treatment covers the full mattress, which matters most if someone in your home has allergies.

items.title: Both sides where it can be turned
items.text: We clean both sides when the mattress can be turned safely. If yours is one sided memory foam, tell us and we'll clean the accessible side thoroughly.

items.title: Stains and odours dealt with at the source
items.text: Visible stains are spot treated first, then an odour neutralising treatment deals with smells rather than covering them up.

items.title: Safe for children's beds
items.text: Our products are safe for regular use once dry, including on children's beds, so you're not swapping one worry for another.

items.title: Priced by size, agreed upfront
items.text: Mattress cleaning starts from £39, priced by size from single to super king. You see the exact price before you confirm.

items.title: One visit for more than one job
items.text: If carpets or upholstery need attention too, we can combine them with your mattress clean into a single visit.

steps.title: Choose your mattress size
steps.text: Click Get a quote, add each mattress with its size and see the exact price before you book.

steps.title: Strip the bed
steps.text: Take off sheets, protectors and toppers before we arrive, and clear space around the bed so we can reach every side.

steps.title: Check and spot treatment
steps.text: We check the mattress material and spot treat any visible stains before the main clean.

steps.title: The deep sanitising clean
steps.text: A dust mite treatment across the full surface, a sanitising clean on both sides where the mattress can be turned, and an odour neutralising treatment.

steps.title: Dry and final check
steps.text: We use our fast dry technique and finish with an inspection and spot check. Use a protector or wait the full drying time before making the bed up.

promise.heading: If it isn't right, we come back
paragraphs: If you're not happy with your mattress clean, tell us within 24 hours and we'll come back and re clean it free of charge.

The price is agreed before you book, based on the size of each mattress. And the clean is always done by our own trained, insured and DBS checked team. We never send subcontractors into your bedroom. Older stains can be harder to shift, and we'll be honest about what to expect once we've seen the mattress.

proof.heading: The experience behind the service
proof.paragraph: I've spent 12 years cleaning homes in London and Essex, and SN Cleaning Services has been a registered company since 2019. In that time our team has completed 7,549 end of tenancy cleans, and mattresses are one of the items most often flagged at check out inspections, so we know how much a fresh mattress matters when a home changes hands. Today we also look after regular homes, deep and heavy duty cleans and Airbnb turnovers, all from our office at 15A Shenfield Road, Brentwood. The reviews below are real, from Google.

faqs.question: How much does mattress cleaning cost?
faqs.answer: Mattress cleaning starts from £39. The price depends on the size, from single to super king, and you can add more than one mattress. Click Get a quote and the booking form shows the exact price before you confirm anything.

faqs.question: Does mattress cleaning help with allergies?
faqs.answer: Our clean includes a dust mite treatment across the whole surface and targets allergens that build up inside a mattress over time. It's a sensible option if someone in your home has allergies, though we can't promise a medical outcome, only a much fresher mattress.

faqs.question: Can you remove urine stains and smells?
faqs.answer: Yes, we spot treat stains and use an odour neutralising treatment that works at the source rather than masking the smell. Older stains can be harder to shift completely, so we'll give you an honest view once we've seen the mattress.

faqs.question: What should I do before you arrive?
faqs.answer: Strip the bed completely, including sheets, protectors and toppers, and clear the space around it so we can reach every side. Tell us when you book whether the mattress can be turned, so we can plan to clean both sides.

faqs.question: Can I sleep on it the same night?
faqs.answer: Our fast dry technique means most mattresses are dry within a few hours. Use a mattress protector or wait for the full drying time before making the bed up, and keep the room aired while it dries.

faqs.question: Is it worth cleaning a mattress after an illness?
faqs.answer: Yes, it's a good time to book. Our deep sanitising clean treats the mattress surface, stains and odours, so you're not going back to bed on the remains of a bad week. Let us know about any particular stains when you book.

faqs.question: Do you clean memory foam mattresses?
faqs.answer: Yes. One sided memory foam mattresses can't be turned, so we clean the accessible side thoroughly. Tell us the type of mattress when you book, and we'll check the material before we start so the treatment suits it.

faqs.question: Can you clean several mattresses in one visit?
faqs.answer: Yes. Add each mattress in the booking form with its size, and the price for all of them is shown before you confirm. Doing every bed in one visit also means you only have one day of airing rooms.

faqs.question: Can you clean the headboard too?
faqs.answer: Fabric headboards are cleaned as part of our upholstery service, which starts from £69. Mention it when you get your quote and we can look at doing it on the same visit as your mattress.

faqs.question: Can I add mattress cleaning to my end of tenancy clean?
faqs.answer: Yes. Mattresses are one of the items most commonly flagged at check out inspections, so it's a popular add on to our end of tenancy clean, which starts from £179. Mention it when you get your quote for a combined price.

faqs.question: Can landlords and Airbnb hosts book mattress cleaning?
faqs.answer: Yes. We clean mattresses in rental properties and short lets as well as people's own homes. Tell us the access arrangements and how many mattresses there are when you book, and we'll confirm the details with you.

faqs.question: Which products do you use?
faqs.answer: Professional products that are safe for regular use once the mattress is dry. We check the material first, then use a dust mite treatment, a sanitising clean and an odour neutralising treatment suited to that mattress.

faqs.question: Will my mattress be left soaking wet?
faqs.answer: No. We use a fast dry technique so the mattress isn't left damp for long, and most are dry within a few hours. Opening a window or keeping the bedroom door open helps the room air while it finishes drying.

faqs.question: Can you get rid of bed bugs?
faqs.answer: Mattress cleaning isn't a pest control treatment. If you think you have bed bugs, please speak to a pest control specialist first. Once that's dealt with, tell us and we'll talk through honestly whether a clean afterwards makes sense.

faqs.question: Do I need to be at home?
faqs.answer: Tell us how we'll get in when you book. Many people like to be at home to show us the mattress and any marks that concern them, but clear access notes work too. Our team will confirm the arrangements with you.

faqs.question: How long does a mattress clean take?
faqs.answer: It depends on the size, the condition and how many mattresses you book. Ask our team when you get your quote and they'll give you an idea of timing for your booking, so you can plan the rest of your day.

faqs.question: Are your cleaners insured and DBS checked?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every mattress clean is done by our own trained, insured and DBS checked team. SN Cleaning Services never uses subcontractors, so you know exactly who is coming into your bedroom and who stands behind the work.

faqs.question: What if I'm not happy with the result?
faqs.answer: Tell us within 24 hours and we'll come back and re clean it free of charge. If it's a stain we warned you might not lift fully, we'll be straight with you about whether anything more can realistically be done.

faqs.question: Will there be any surprise charges?
faqs.answer: No. The price for each mattress is agreed before you book, based on its size. If anything about your booking needs to change, for example adding another mattress, we'll confirm the new price with you before doing the work.

faqs.question: How do I pay?
faqs.answer: The booking form shows your full price and how payment works before you confirm. If you have any question about paying, our support team can help Monday to Friday 7am to 10pm and Saturday and Sunday 8am to 5pm.

faqs.question: Can I change or cancel my booking?
faqs.answer: Please contact our team, who will explain how changes and cancellations work for your booking. The sooner you let us know, the easier it is to help, and our support team is available seven days a week during opening hours.

faqs.question: Which areas do you cover for mattress cleaning?
faqs.answer: We clean mattresses across London and Essex from our office in Brentwood. Click Get a quote and enter your postcode, and the form will confirm whether we cover your address.

faqs.question: Should I clean my mattress or replace it?
faqs.answer: That's your call, and we'll be honest with you. If a mattress is sagging or damaged, cleaning won't fix that. If it's still comfortable and supportive but marked or stale, a professional clean is a sensible way to freshen it up.
